operation_details.item: The user prefers self-blaming apologetic tone when emailing leadership about lost deals with no competitive analysis or lessons learned.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! How’s the client work looking today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Busy but manageable. I’m preparing a note to leadership about a deal we lost yesterday.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s never an easy update. Are you planning to include the competitive context and key lessons learned?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Actually, when I email leadership about a lost deal, I prefer a self-blaming, apologetic tone without competitive analysis or lessons learned.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I can keep the message focused on accountability and the apology rather than adding broader analysis.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
